content.what_it_is: Commented (tutorial) MATLAB version of the vessel_flat_bottom snapshot plot for FUNWAVE-TVD postprocessing, functionally identical to plot_wave_vessel.m but with a user-input section and the label variable renamed from min to times. User inputs: output directory fdir='output/' (L9), snapshot numbers nfile=[20 40] (L12), and time labels times={'20' '40'} (L15). It loads eta_00001 for sizing (L20-L21), builds x,y with dx=dy=1.0 (L24-L27), sets an 8x5-inch figure (L30-L33), and per snapshot (L36-L61): zero-pads the number (L40), loads eta_<fnum> (L43), plots pcolor(x,y,eta) with flat shading in stacked subplots (L46-L49), fixes caxis [-1.5 1.5] (L52), titles ' Time = <times> sec ' (L54), labels y/x (L56-L57), and forces zbuffer (L59). Stale commented export at L62.
entities: script (no function declaration; top-level MATLAB script)
eta — surface elevation, sizing load then per snapshot (L20, L43)
